description: This file defines the Marketing model class within the OpenCart admin module. It includes methods for creating, updating, deleting, and retrieving marketing entities and associated reports in the database.

classes.name: Marketing
classes.description: Model class handling marketing and marketing report operations in the OpenCart admin system.

methods.name: addMarketing
methods.description: Inserts a new marketing record into the database and returns its ID.

methods.name: editMarketing
methods.description: Updates an existing marketing record identified by marketing_id.

methods.name: deleteMarketing
methods.description: Deletes a marketing record and its associated reports from the database.

methods.name: getMarketing
methods.description: Retrieves a marketing record by its ID.

methods.name: getMarketingByCode
methods.description: Fetches a marketing record by its unique code.

methods.name: getMarketings
methods.description: Retrieves a list of marketing records with optional filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalMarketings
methods.description: Returns the total count of marketing records matching optional filters.

methods.name: deleteReports
methods.description: Deletes all report entries associated with a specific marketing_id.

methods.name: getReports
methods.description: Retrieves reports related to a specific marketing campaign with pagination.

methods.name: getTotalReports
methods.description: Counts the total number of reports for a specific marketing ID.
